lines.zh: 我贴着海沟壁一寸寸挪。
lines.en: I inch along the trench wall.
A flick of my fins, and I slide into the dark.

lines.zh: 我绕着温水的石缝打转。
lines.en: I circle the warm stone crevices.

lines.zh: 头顶两只眼睛朝天看路。
lines.en: Both eyes on my crown watch the water above.
One swish of my tail clears the ledge.
I drift upward on the warm current.
Inside my clear head, my eyes keep turning.
I slip through a narrow trench gap.
I skim the sand without a sound.
The warm water carries me forward.

lines.zh: 我一抖身，钻进海草影里。
lines.en: A shiver, and I vanish into the kelp shade.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，像块碎玻璃。
lines.en: I swim slowly, like a shard of glass.
Two tube eyes stay fixed above me.

lines.zh: 我在海沟底画了个小圈。
lines.en: I trace a small circle on the trench floor.

lines.zh: 我头朝下，眼睛还看着上面。
lines.en: My head points down, my eyes still watch above.

lines.zh: 窄缝里我把鳍收了起来。
lines.en: In the narrow gap I fold my fins in.

lines.zh: 一股冷水推我偏了半尺。
lines.en: A cold current shoves me off by half a foot.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退进海沟的暗处。
lines.en: I drift back into the dark of the trench.

lines.zh: 透明脑袋里，眼睛慢慢转。
lines.en: Inside my clear head, my eyes turn slowly.
Something passes; I hold my breath.
I cannot blink, so I just turn.

lines.zh: 上方有影子，我压低身子。
lines.en: A shadow above; I sink lower.
I count the grains of sand drifting down.
The warm water makes me drowsy.
The eyes on my head swivel on their own.

lines.zh: 我听见远处鲨鱼的尾音。
lines.en: Far off, I hear a shark's tail beat.
Small things stir inside the crevice.
I turn sideways and rest.
A little light leaks down from the surface.
I hold half a mouthful of water.
The trench is deep; I cannot be bothered.
I wait for one careless little swimmer.

lines.zh: 你这大影子挡住我的光。
lines.en: Your big shadow blocks my light.
I look up at your feet from below.
You stand above; I float in the trench.
No scales on you at all; how strange.
I tilt up and aim both eyes at you.
Do you eat small fish too?
I hide behind a rock and watch you.
When you move, the water shakes.
Can you see through my clear head?
Do not step down; I am right here.
One hit and I lose a heart.
I am belly-up; help me quick.
That blow left me dizzy.
A scale came loose.

lines.zh: 杀我，只掉一块萤光黏液。
lines.en: Kill me and you get only glowing slime.
The water turned red.
It hurts; I dive into the rocks.
I cannot even tell who hit me.
My whole body is trembling.
Easy, I have no shell at all.
Is that fish food? I smell it.
Let those scraps drift a little closer.
That lump in your hand is wriggling.
I am hungry, yet I keep my distance.
Let me peck once and go.
I circle you three times.
Even tiny crumbs will do.
My mouth is small; I cannot bite big things.
In warm water, food smell spreads fast.
If you feed me, scatter it in the water.
Your bump flipped me over.
I'm smaller than your palm; don't bump me.
My scales are slick; it does not hurt.
You churned the water full of bubbles.
I slip past the side of your leg.
Bump me again and I hide in the rocks.
One stomp and the trench floor rings.
Your shove spun me twice around.
Careful, I have only three hearts.
After the bump I swim right back.
I want one with bright eyes.
I circle her once, fins spread.
In warm water we make a pair.
I drift close; she does not flinch.
Side by side, we slip into the crevice.
I flutter my fins as a greeting.
Partners are scarce down in the trench.
She is clearer than me, and prettier.
I swim above her, keeping watch.
Two small fish, drifting as one.
I cannot hold anything in my mouth.
I try lifting this little stone.
Too heavy; I let it go.
I only pick up tiny bits.
Carrying things slows my swimming.
I will keep this grain of sand.

lines.zh: 那小东西卡在我眼睛旁边。
lines.en: The little thing lodges beside my eyes.
I prefer the shiny ones.
When your hand comes, I drop it.
Done picking, I sink to the trench floor.
That shadow up there is moving.
I smell shark; time to hide.
I fix on a tiny swimmer.

lines.zh: 透明脑袋里的眼睛转过去了。
lines.en: The eyes in my clear head have turned that way.
I tuck into the crevice and hold still.
It is bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 两只管子眼睛，一齐对准它。
lines.en: Both tube eyes lock onto it.
The ripples are wrong; something nears.
I look first, then decide to flee.
It opened its mouth; I should go.
It circles; I turn with it.
I back away along the sand.
My eyes lock on its mouth.
Given a chance, I dart into a gap.
When it speeds up, I scatter.
I pretend to be a piece of clear stone.
Tail taut, ready to bolt.
It cannot see inside my head.
I count the rhythm of its tail.
Too close; I press into the dark.
I can only peck at its fin.
I nip the loose skin on its tail.
I am too small to win this.
Peck and run; do not look back.
One tail swipe and I am flung away.
I butt my snout at its gill cover.
I clamp onto a single scale.
One hit, and I retreat three lengths.
Its hide is thick; my teeth do nothing.
I only want it out of my crevice.

lines.zh: 我从暖海沟的水里出现。
lines.en: I surface out of the warm trench water.
The sand stirs, and I swim out.
Two small fish open their eyes together.
The trench current lifts me up.

lines.zh: 我一出生就往石头缝钻。
lines.en: Born, and straight into the rocks.
My crown eyes see the light first.
My clear head is full of brightness.
The water here is warm, just right.
A flick of fins, and I claim this spot.
Do not crowd; the trench has room.
The water is boiling; I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我从水里被摔到石头上。
lines.en: I got flung from water onto stone.
Drowning in water? That is absurd.
A blast rings out; my head hurts.

lines.zh: 箭贴着我的透明头顶滑过去。
lines.en: The arrow slid right past my see-through head.
Some strange force shoves me aside.
I am starving down to bone.
Lightning hit the surface; I went numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我只能乱摆。
lines.en: No water in the void; I just flail.
